title: Part Five: Work: Wages, Hours and the Frozen Floors

sections.brief: Federal floors as fixed dollar sums: FLSA 1938; minimum wage history to $7.25 (24 July 2009), EPI real value 2025$ ($12.11 in 1968, $10.45 in 2009, $7.25 in 2025: -40%/-31%); states (30 + DC above, avg $11.51); BLS 2024 (843,000 at or below, 1.0%); full-time $15,080 vs 2026 poverty guideline $15,960; tipped cash wage $2.13 since 1991 (1996 decoupling); overtime salary test $30 (1938) to $155 (1975), $455 (2004), $913 enjoined (2016), $684 (2020), 2024 rule vacated 15 Nov 2024, appeals dropped (status Oct 2026); SSI $2,000/$3,000 since 1989 and $20/$65 exclusions; $600 1099 threshold (1954) raised to $2,000 and indexed by OBBBA; CBO 2019 $15 trade-offs; both parties' records; labelled Interpretation passage with counter-readings. Figures: time; compare (told vs record); money

Multiple jobholding 5.4% (2025), 5.5% (Sept 2026) vs 6.8% peak 1995; reasons (2004: 25.6% expenses/debt); hours (OECD caution on annual levels; usual weekly 38.2; 50+ hours 8.9%); no federal paid vacation, sick leave 81%, paid family leave 13% vs 44%; mothers' participation 47% (1975) to 73.9% (2025), both parents work 66.3%; Warren & Tyagi two-income trap vs Bruenig critique (contested); childcare NDCP $6,552–$15,600, OECD 20%/37%; CCDF 7% cap (2024) repealed May 2026. Figures: stats; flow; compare

Monopsony defined; Manning 2021, Caldwell-Dube-Naidu 2026; Azar et al. 17% vs Rinz (falling local concentration, ~1% typical) vs Benmelech et al.; noncompetes (Starr et al. 18%/38%; FTC rule 23 Apr 2024, vacated 20 Aug 2024 Ryan LLC, appeals dropped 5 Sept 2025); licensing (<5% 1950s to ~25%; 21.6% 2025; premium and mobility costs); job lock (Madrian 1994; Gallup 2026 24%); wage theft (Broken Laws 2009; EPI 2017 $8bn/$15bn with caveats; DOL-ERG 2014 lower rates; recoveries $1.5bn 2021–23; unauthorised workers). Figures: money; compare (designed vs deviant friction)
